items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Yeah, that's what got me stuck on the trombone by looking at Frankie Duesen.

ctx.x: They'd come up there that way.

Yeah, that's what got me stuck on the trombone by looking at Frankie Duesen. I was a little kid, but I used to like that. You liked that? I'd stare in under the band from the time to get there till the time to leave.
He was a pretty good trombonist, Frankie Duesen?
